raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since the 2026-01-17 source change, a reversal arrives as a separate REVERSAL record pointing to the original via orig_txn_id, and the original stays POSTED. The 40 REVERSAL rows reference originals from batch 13 onward, so the pipeline's status = 'POSTED' filter now keeps reversed transactions and inflates recent gold totals. The fix excludes any POSTED transaction referenced by a REVERSAL record, which matches the old behaviour where reversed originals had status REVERSED and were filtered out.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id)"}}
